title: Map sheets no longer mismatch zoom
description:
After the Refine edges bug, some Map Builder sheets kept an inflated native size while CSS still scaled them by ~2.8×. Those tiles looked zoomed in compared to neighbors, so puzzle seams no longer lined up.

Opening a map workspace now heals that geometry: true native size is restored from layout ÷ display scale, every sheet is normalized to the same map layout scale, and reconcile will not re-inflate nat from layout size.

Who is affected: PipeSync Map Building on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh PipeSync, then reopen the map workspace (or switch away and back).
changeLog: Auto-heal map pages whose nat size was inflated to layout size.
Normalize all map sheets to the same viewDispScale layout.
Stop reconcile from setting nat = layout when display scale is set.
Re-raster map sheets after geometry heal.
